digest.component_or_area: CI fetch optimization and workflow guards
propositions: CI tickets-store fetch operations incur excessive transfer costs (1.04–6.73 minutes, 1.4–6.73 GiB) that can be reduced by applying blob:none filter to named-origin and direct-URL fetch paths.
blob:none filter must be added to actions/checkout@v7 in reconcile-bridge, verify-identity, and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows while preserving fetch-depth:0 and existing credential/ref inputs.
Gerrit verify.yaml direct-URL fetches require explicit --filter=blob:none: depth-1 require-ticket fetch and full-history verify-identity fetch, retaining their respective depth semantics.
Production guards must parse git count-objects size-pack output and enforce limits (102400 KiB for standalone, 131072 KiB for Gerrit materialized) immediately after fetch and materialization.

Real-Git fixture using git daemon with temporary GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL must prove filter capability advertisement, client filter blob:none protocol requests, missing-blob behavior, and pack size contrasts between unfiltered and blobless fetches.
Blobless materialization with worktree add must not introduce promisor fetch side effects during identity scanning, verified by exact before/after git count-objects snapshots.
